## Checklist

- [ ] Code is clean, readable and follows the existing structure
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] Lint passes with no warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] No accessibility regressions (labels, keyboard, contrast)
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed (README / DECISIONS)
